Class FundamentalDataLoadService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.fundamental.FundamentalDataLoadService
@Service public class FundamentalDataLoadService extends Object
Loads the fundamental base values of the direct equities in scope from every enabled source and stores them graded.

Each source runs on its own thread with its own pause, so the slowest rate limit sets the duration rather than the sum of all. A 401 or 403 answer stops that source for the rest of the run, since the key or plan is the cause; any other failure fails that security for that source. Afterwards, per security in one transaction, the rows of every source that gave a usable answer are replaced by that answer, the rows of a source that failed stay as they were, the source checks run with the current last price, and the selection grades the combined rows.
